page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head "GRAMMATICA" and page number "4" at the top. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: klugste[?]/from[?]/frommer/frommeste. Vocales autem & Diphthongi positivi mutantur in Comparativo & Superlativo, videlicet a ine/ o inö/ u inü/ au in eu: ut, lang/lögus, lenger/lengste. Groß/magnus, größ-ser/größte. Jung/juvenis, jünger/jüngste. Braun/fuscus, breuner/breunste. Excipe gut/ besser/beste/bonus, melior, optimus. Böß/erger/ergste/malus, peior, pessimus. Viel/mehr/meiste/multum, plus, plurimum.
Quinque: Masculinum, Foemininum, Neutrum, Commune & Omne.
Cujus nota est articulus der: ut, der Mann/Vir.

Primo, quae viro, aut rebus viri specie conceptis congruunt: ut, der Vatter/ Pater, der König/ Rex, der Jenner/Januarius, der Mey/Majus: Deinde desinentia in b/d/f/g/h/k/l/m/n/r/s/t/w/y/z: ut, der leib/ corpus, der sand/ arena, der schlaff/somnus, der tag/dies, der fisch/piscis, der speck/lardum, der stahl/chalybs, der leim/gluten, der schrein[?]/cista, der ingwer/zingiber, der flachs/linum, der mist/fimus, der taw/ros, der blitz/fulgur, der schatz/thesaurus. His adde der bien/puls & der Weihe/Milvus: ut, Alle reine vögel esset. Das sind sie aber die ihr nicht essen solt: der Adler/ der Habicht / der Fischar/ der Teucher/der Weihe. Sagt D. Luther in den Teutschen Biblien/im V. Buch Mose/am XIV. Cap.
Cujus nota est articulus die: ut, die Frawe/foemina.
Primo, quae mulieri, aut rebus mulieris specie cō-ceptis

page.notes: Top-left line 1 begins with a fragment; first letter partly lost, read as "k" with [?]. "from" in "frosi" is doubtful. The umlaut forms in "a ine/ o inö/ u inü/ au in eu" are printed in a compressed way and approximate. "schrein" for "schzein" is doubtful. The final letter series "w/y/z" in the consonant list is doubtful. Black letter German words are marked with bl; some article forms may be roman in print. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. The last line is cut at the scan edge and may be incomplete.
